evidenceLineage.note: Evidence is bound to the exact tree executed by this run; any later source change invalidates it.

failureClasses.PRODUCT: Product defect: product code produced the observed wrong state.
failureClasses.HARNESS: Harness defect: the probe/eval itself threw or asserted on missing state.
failureClasses.ENVIRONMENT: Environment difference that does not implicate product or oracle.
failureClasses.ORACLE: Oracle defect: the assertion asks for state the contract does not require.
failureClasses.EVIDENCE: Evidence defect: capture/lineage of the produced artifact is unusable.
failureClasses.LINEAGE: Lineage defect: the receipt candidate does not match the executed source.
failureClasses.UNKNOWN: Evidence cannot yet separate PRODUCT from ORACLE/HARNESS.
